name: web3-analytics-dashboard
description: Portfolio-grade Web3 Analytics Dashboard with hybrid blockchain support

scripts.install:all: cd blockchain && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.deploy:local: cd blockchain && npx --no-install hardhat run scripts/deploy.js --network localhost
scripts.seed: cd blockchain && npx --no-install hardhat run scripts/seed.js --network localhost
scripts.deploy:sepolia: cd blockchain && npx --no-install hardhat run scripts/deploy.js --network sepolia
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run compile && echo ✅ Setup complete!
scripts.predeploy: echo Deploying dashboard to GitHub Pages...
